leaves.why_cant_go_deeper: The City pays hospital and doctor bills for thousands of workers as the bills come in, and it does not publish who each worker is or what each claim cost.
leaves.note: 2025 payments: Blue Cross $610.0M in 68 checks (14 checks of $10M or more, largest $43.6M) and Caremark (pharmacy) $129.6M in 53 checks. Dental, vision and life premium vendors (Delta Dental, Davis Vision, MetLife) are small or not in this line. These payments are all funds, 2025, so they do not tie to the $408.7M Corporate Fund line.
